llm.summary: This skill coherently monitors DigitalOcean droplets using a disclosed API token and read-only API requests.

dimensions.detail: A DigitalOcean API token is sensitive, but its use is disclosed and proportionate to fetching droplet metrics; users should prefer a least-privilege read-only token where possible.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill requires python3 and a DIGITALOCEAN_TOKEN environment variable; no third-party dependencies, package installs, or remote code loading were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are explicit command examples that invoke the local Python helper; there are no hidden prompt overrides, agent-control instructions, or unrelated workflows in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill suggests storing the token in ~/.openclaw/.env, which is expected credential persistence for this integration; the script itself does not create persistence, services, hooks, or scheduled tasks.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is DigitalOcean VPS monitoring, and the bundled script lists droplets and fetches CPU, memory, disk, and bandwidth metrics from DigitalOcean monitoring endpoints.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want Codex to query your DigitalOcean account for droplet inventory and monitoring data. Use a scoped or read-only token if available, keep the token out of shared logs, and expect command output to include server names, IDs, regions, statuses, and raw metric time series.
